what: LiDAR Vegetation Encroachment and Fall-In Risk for Power Line Corridors
title: LiDAR Vegetation Encroachment and Fall-In Risk for Power Line Corridors
text: Screening transmission corridor vegetation risk public airborne LiDAR, R. vegrisk small R package plus reproducible case study. takes USGS 3DEP point clouds (LAS/LAZ) OpenStreetMap power-line geometry produces segment--segment screen two vegetation failure modes utilities manage: Grow-: canopy growing clearance envelope beneath conductors. Fall-: “strike trees” beside line tall enough reach conductor fall. case study Sunshine–Boulder Hydro 115 kV line Sunshine Canyon, Boulder County, Colorado. ’s wildland–urban interface: 2010 Fourmile Canyon Fire burned 2.5 km north-west. Inputs 1.46 km line, 2.2 M -ground LiDAR points (USGS CO_DRCOG_2020, ~35 pts/m²), 5 tagged OSM structures, 33 OSM buildings.

title: Assign weak labels to featurised points — weak_labels
text: feat Output point_features(). crs CRS point cloud. lines, structures, buildings sf layers OSM (CRS). cell_m 2D cell size air-gap test. gap_floor_m Points height ignored air-gap test (grass, fences, shrubs). lower featurisation floor. layer_m Maximum vertical thickness suspended cell's points (allows vertically stacked phases shield wire). gap_m Depth empty space required beneath cell's lowest point across 3 x 3 window. wire_min_m Minimum height wire label. wire_search_m Wire labels assigned within horizontal distance mapped line (covers OSM misalignment phase spacing). run_half_m, row_m, min_run, min_extent_m, min_occupancy Along-line run test. candidate cell, "row" candidates within run_half_m chainage row_m perpendicular offset (one conductor; parallel phases form separate rows). row qualifies least min_run cells, spans least min_extent_m along line, occupies least min_occupancy 1 m chainage bins across span. members qualifying row wire. structure_radius_m Radius around pole/tower nodes. building_shrink_m Inward buffer applied building footprints. margin_m Width unlabelled margin around non-vegetation labels.
